inputs.text: KPN telephone network fault since 15:34: 112 and the police number 0900-8844 are unreachable nationwide. Police technicians have opened two alternative 088 numbers that route around the KPN network; the police and the ministry have each checked that calls to these numbers reach the 112 centre. Police Twitter account @Politiemelding is available.

fields.description: A KPN telephone network fault since 15:34 means emergency number 112 and police number 0900-8844 cannot be reached anywhere in the Netherlands. It is not yet known when this will be fixed.
fields.headline: 112 and police number 0900-8844 unreachable nationwide
fields.instruction: In an emergency, call [INSERT 088 NUMBER 1] or [INSERT 088 NUMBER 2] instead of 112. Updates are posted on Twitter at @Politiemelding.
left_out: No unverified inputs were received, so nothing was left out for that reason.
The two alternative 088 phone numbers are not in the input. I did not make them up. Placeholders mark where they go.
fields.note_for_reviewer: Do not send this until the two verified 088 numbers replace the placeholders. Without them the instruction gives people no usable way to reach the 112 centre. No end time was given, so the message says it is not yet known.
